decisions.notes: The 12-view sheet is dominated by a large curved ground mesh, despite removing it from the active scene. The car is too small to assess; reject this package and fix the isolation before reinspection.
limitations: No quality, interior, motion or logo assessment is possible from this framing.

decisions.notes: Inspected twelve views: plausible aircraft outline and engines, but flat windows and simplified clean surfaces resemble a display model; cockpit and interior are not modeled or verified.
limitations: Static glTF; no clips or armatures, nine validator warnings; interior not verified.
